response.justification: Bogdan is a highly experienced, versatile full-stack engineer (15+ years) with direct current experience in TypeScript/Node.js and AI-agent/MCP tooling, plus exposure to React, MongoDB, AWS, Docker/Kubernetes, and multiple languages (Java, C#, D). His breadth exceeds the 6+ year requirement and he has strong TDD/testing craftsmanship, though explicit Nest.js and Vitest/Jest experience isn't clearly documented in recent roles.
strengths: Extensive full-stack experience (15+ years) spanning frontend, backend, mobile, and embedded systems
Current hands-on experience with TypeScript/Node.js and AI-agent infrastructure (MCP), directly matching the AI agent development requirement
Strong engineering craftsmanship: TDD, CI/CD, testing frameworks/tools he's built himself, and technical talks/workshops showing deep expertise
concerns: No explicit mention of Nest.js or Vitest/Jest, key primary-stack technologies for the role
Recent frontend work leans on Ember.js rather than React, with React experience limited mainly to the Optilyz role
No Kotlin experience mentioned, and cloud/container exposure (AWS, Docker, Kubernetes) is present but not deeply detailed

key_factors.factor: Broad, senior full-stack background across many stacks
Gaps in primary stack specifics (Nest.js, Vitest, recent React depth)
